name: DataDelivers
oneLiner: Restaurant-specific customer data platform that unifies POS, loyalty, online ordering and reservation data and matches anonymous card transactions to marketable guest profiles (Guest Connect).
bestFor: Mid-sized and multi-unit restaurant brands that want to reach and measure the guests who are not in their loyalty program.

updates.text: Published its 2025 Restaurant Guest Engagement Report on guest retention, based on data from tens of millions of guests across 2,000+ restaurant locations.

features: Ingests and unifies POS, loyalty, e-club, online ordering and reservation data into one guest view
Guest Connect matches anonymous credit card and POS transactions against a proprietary consumer dataset to build profiles of non-loyalty guests
Appends data to fill gaps in thin guest records
Segmentation and audience building for targeted email and digital campaigns
Prospect targeting for new restaurant openings
Campaign measurement tying marketing to visits and sales
Integrations with common restaurant POS, loyalty, email and ordering providers (including an Olo partnership)
notes: Customer coverage is from 2022-2024 trade press; no 2026 press release found. Update month for the 2025 report could not be confirmed (date given as year only). Guest/transaction counts differ between the 2025 and 2026 reports in search results, so left out. Vendor claims such as 'only 15-20% of guests are in loyalty programs' are self-reported and left out. 'Custom pricing based on data volume' in the current review could not be confirmed; changed to custom pricing. Bebee lists Baja Fresh, Taco Time, Planet Smoothie and Sweet Frog as clients, but that source is weak, so left out.
